bug.dissect.description: dissect the bug report into the dissection document; while no valid dissection is recorded

change.fix.description: fix the code so the reproducing test passes, without changing that test; admissible only once the red is recorded; the writer again after a failed suite run or a failed gate

dissection.check.description: check the current dissection; once per dissection revision, and only once the writer has left one (a check of a dissection that does not exist yet would end the case not_reproduced)

gate.run.description: run the code tree's gate on the current fix revision, once the suite passes and the story is updated; once per code revision

repro.run.description: run the reproducing test on the code tree; once per repro revision, once the dissection is valid and the test writer has left a repro record (a run against no test would end the case not_reproduced)

story.update.description: move the bug's story to implemented in the planning store (create it first when no parent handed it in), once the suite passes on the fix

test.reproduce.description: write one test that reproduces the bug, into the code tree and the repro record, without changing any other file; once the dissection is valid and while no red is recorded

tests.run.description: run the whole suite on the current fix revision; once per code revision

change.description: the code tree; its revision is its content digest

dissection.description: the bug report dissected into a data document: observed, expected, where, how to reproduce

report.description: the bug report, the case's input (bug.yaml)

repro.description: the reproducing test: one test file and the record naming its test id; written once the dissection is valid, kept as written by every later step

story.description: the planning store holding the bug's story

change.built.description: the current code revision is a fix written after the red record

dissection.checked.description: a check is recorded about the current dissection, whatever its result

dissection.written.description: the current dissection revision is the output of a dissection writer run

gate.checked.description: a gate run is recorded about the current code revision, whatever its result

gate.passed.description: the gate passes on the current code revision

repro.checked.description: a run of the current reproducing test is recorded, whatever its result

repro.red.description: the current reproducing test was observed red on the unchanged code

repro.written.description: the current repro revision is the output of a test writer run

story.updated.description: the bug's story is implemented in the current planning store

tests.pass.description: the reproducing test and the whole suite pass on the current code revision

tests.run_recorded.description: a suite run is recorded about the current code revision, whatever its result

dissection_check.description: a program's check of the dissection against its schema and the code tree; valid or invalid

dissection_written.description: the record that the dissection writer ran and left the dissection document at a new revision

gate_run.description: the code tree's gate run by a program: build, test, lint with warnings as errors, format check; passed or failed

implementation_change.description: the record that the fix moved the code tree to a new revision

repro_run.description: a program runs the reproducing test on the code tree with the code otherwise unchanged; red when the test compiles and fails and every other test passes, not_red otherwise (it passes, it does not compile, another test fails, or the code was changed)

repro_written.description: the record that the test writer ran and left the repro record at a new revision

story_record.description: the record that the bug's story was moved to implemented in the planning store

test_run.description: a program runs the whole suite on a code revision; passed when the reproducing test is unchanged, reported ok under its test id, and nothing fails or is ignored

fixed.description: the reproducing test was red on the unchanged code, the fix passes it and the whole suite, the story is implemented and the gate passes

not_fixed.description: the bug was reproduced, but the fix fails the suite or the gate (ends the case once the writer is spent)

not_reproduced.description: no valid dissection, or no test that is red on the unchanged code (ends the case once the writers are spent)

protocol.description: Fix one reported bug in an existing code tree, red first: the bug report is dissected into a checked data document, a test that reproduces the bug is written and observed failing on the unchanged code while the rest of the suite passes, and only then is the fix admissible; the same test and the whole suite must pass on the fixed revision, the bug's story is moved to implemented, and the code tree's gate (build, test, lint, format) passes. One case, no child cases; its inputs are the bug report and the code tree in the case's work directory, so a parent can open it as a child. No approval in this revision: a merge approval is the next addition.
